items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: I talked with Joe when I was in California.

ctx.x: Well, the reason why I believe they don't talk too much about Caffrey. Caffrey was a little touchy. He was awful touchy.
Is he any relation to Joe Dyeronsburg, the clarinet player? I asked...
I talked with Joe when I was in California. I doubt seriously whether there's a close connection there or not. He's a fine fellow.
